silhouette.reason: Raised forebody with a narrow hood, ventral scutes and a single flat coil read as a cobra; the coil is one loose loop, not a stack supporting the raised body.
fixes: stack one more coil under the raised forebody
widen the hood ribs a little at the neck

proportions.reason: Girth now swells mid-body and tapers to the tail; the head is small against the hood in FRONT.

materials.reason: Ventral cream scutes and a dark dorsum; the dorsal pattern is now pale crossbands instead of rattlesnake zigzags, though their edges are serrated rather than clean chevrons pointing to the head, and the dorsum is matte apart from a blue-grey patch on the coil.
fixes: sharpen the crossbands into chevrons that point toward the head
low roughness on the dorsal scales

detail.reason: Ventral scutes, dorsal scale pattern, tongue and head shields read at hero distance.

wear.reason: Nothing says this snake has lived anywhere: no shed patch, scar or dust.
fixes: a dull pre-shed patch or a healed scar

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 now averages the pattern into an olive-dark coil, but two coil segments still turn blue-grey and the neck goes flat cream, so the colour still shifts at distance.
fixes: average the blue-grey patch into the dorsal tone at LOD2
keep a darker dorsal band on the LOD2 neck

technical.reason: 61.9k / 9.2k / 584 triangles, one draw; LOD1 now holds, LOD0 spends uniform rings along the straight neck.
fixes: lower LOD0 ring density on the straight neck and tail
